task.description: Implement the API-02 HTTP handler layer for Process definition CRUD per the design at src/design/api-02-definition-crud.md. Implement all missing route handlers in src/api/routes/definitions.zig: handleCreate (POST /api/v1/definitions), handlePut (PUT /api/v1/definitions/:id), handlePatch (PATCH /api/v1/definitions/:id), handleDelete (DELETE /api/v1/definitions/:id), handleActivate (POST /api/v1/definitions/:id/activate). Also add Store.update() and Store.hardDelete() methods to src/definition/store.zig if they do not already exist. Wire all new routes in src/main.zig. All seven acceptance criteria from API-02 must be satisfied. Apply role guards, HTTP status codes, and error responses per the design artefact.
acceptance_criteria: DELETE /definitions/:id: hard delete DRAFT (204), archive ACTIVE/DEPRECATED (200), 404 if not found
POST /definitions/:id/activate: 409 if status != DRAFT, triggers PD-02 validation
All write operations on non-DRAFT return HTTP 422 for validation failures
All new routes wired in src/main.zig or equivalent router

result.summary: Implemented API-02 handlers: handleCreate, handlePut, handlePatch, handleDelete, handleActivate, handleDeprecate, handleArchive in src/api/routes/definitions.zig. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
